'''2012 Alderaan Regionals Chris Schoenthal DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Schoenthal]] at [[2012 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]]
* '''Username:''' imrahil327
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
